anchors.+3A: reported only where N >= 300 per block, else descriptive
capture_only: T0 = entry bar (first 1s bar after the T0 observation)

capture: T0 events: real vs null final_mfe, final_pnl, capture = final_pnl/final_mfe (final_mfe > 0; also ratio of means), giveback; residual capture; also for the top final-MFE quintile (outcome-defined, descriptive only)

decision_rule.EXCESS_CONTINUATION_RESIDUAL: excess_continuation state(s) and no excess_giveback state
decision_rule.EXCESS_GIVEBACK_RESIDUAL: excess_giveback state(s) and no excess_continuation state
decision_rule.INCONCLUSIVE: only if the DISCOVERY-block MDE for final_pnl tercile residuals exceeds 0.10 A at every primary anchor (the economic question cannot be bounded); power alone never triggers it otherwise
decision_rule.TRIGGER_LAG_IS_TRADEOFF - MECHANICALLY_N: no excess_giveback and no excess_continuation state, and no anchor has a meaningful overall final_pnl residual that replication does not contradict
decision_rule.mandatory: if residual giveback and add_mfe curves by lag match the engine null within the development MDE -> MECHANICALLY_NEUTRAL; no exit-policy experiment on expectancy grounds; stop
decision_rule.overall_pnl_residual_note: a meaningful overall (not lag-specific) final_pnl residual that is not lag-specific is reported as UNIFORM_RESIDUAL alongside the verdict

execution.decision_price: close of the flip 1m bar (= last 1s close at the flip timestamp)
execution.decomposition: MFE-to-exit giveback = (final MFE - decision location) [boundary component] + (decision location - exit location) [fill gap]
execution.exit: audited: OPEN of the first 1s bar after the flip (terminal_exit_price)
execution.parity: real exit price == first-1s-open after the flip; terminal_gross_pnl_atr == (exit-entry)*dir/atr_entry_1m

lag_measures_at_anchor.catchup1: trig_pos now - trig_pos one completed minute earlier
lag_measures_at_anchor.trig_pos: pre-bar bound relative to entry (A, + = protected)

meaningful.continuous: |mean residual| >= 0.10 A with CI excluding 0 (0.10 A ~ 0.9 NQ pt at the 2023 median 1m ATR ~ 8.6 pt, the order of round-trip friction; the frame carries no cost column)

outcomes_per_event.add_mfe: final_mfe - MFE through the anchor bar
outcomes_per_event.final_mfe: max favourable excursion from entry through the flip bar (A)
outcomes_per_event.final_pnl: terminal gross P&L in A (real: audited)
outcomes_per_event.null: per event: mean over the K=64 engine-null paths that flip before the session close / 2 h cap (unflipped share reported; the real population is conditioned on a flip)

population: the 6,024 audited 2023 development trades; discovery = first 154 sessions, replication = next 51; final 20% dark; 2024-2026 untouched
power: MDE (80%, two-sided 5%) per block, anchor and outcome from the session-cluster SE of the REAL outcome (no residual means read); used ONLY to label replication as NOT_SHOWN_AT_AVAILABLE_POWER, never to decide the verdict
question: Does the existing opposite-1m-regime exit behave differently on real NQ post-entry paths than the same exit behaves on driftless paths?

replication_labels.CONTRADICTED: opposite sign (or same sign but replication MDE <= |discovery effect| and CI includes 0)
replication_labels.DIRECTIONAL: same sign, CI crosses 0, replication MDE > |discovery effect|  -> NOT_SHOWN_AT_AVAILABLE_POWER

residual: per event real - null; aggregated by lag tercile (cutpoints fixed on DISCOVERY at each anchor) and overall
reuse: mechanical_null.py replay_engine / simulate / build_session, EXTENDED in place behind an opt-in econ flag
robustness: long/short, initial MTF states >= 150 events, RTH segments -- for claimed effects only
simulator_extension_parity: re-running the extended build must reproduce every existing null_p_* column of EVENT_LEVEL bit-for-bit (same RNG stream, same draws); new anchors (T0, +3A) and previously 'decided' events use a SEPARATE rng stream
speed: time_to_anchor terciles (discovery cutpoints), RTH-segment stratified [08:30-10:30),[10:30-13:30),[13:30-close) CT; raw vs residual; sensitivity excluding anchors < 3600 s before the close

states.excess_continuation: a lag tercile where residual add_mfe >= +0.10 A AND residual final_pnl >= +0.10 A (both meaningful) at >= 2 adjacent primary anchors in discovery, replication not CONTRADICTED
states.excess_giveback: a lag tercile where residual giveback >= +0.10 A AND residual final_pnl <= -0.10 A (both meaningful) at >= 2 adjacent primary anchors in discovery, replication not CONTRADICTED

statistics: session-cluster bootstrap 95% CI (1000 reps, seed 20260928); Spearman(lag, residual) reported alongside terciles

trigger_semantics.long_flip_on_completed_1m_bar: c < a3*l + (1-a3)*E3_low_prev AND c < a9*l + (1-a9)*E9_low_prev (strict), a3=1/2, a9=1/5; short mirrored with highs and >
trigger_semantics.parity: (close beyond realized threshold) must equal the engine's flipped flag on every in-trade minute; exact
trigger_semantics.pre_bar_bound: long min(E3_low, E9_low), short max(E3_high, E9_high) of the engine state after the last COMPLETED minute -- the only trigger quantity used as an anchor-time explanatory variable
trigger_semantics.realized_threshold: long min_k(a_k*l + (1-a_k)*E_k_prev) using that bar's own low -- OUTCOME-side, timeline only
